items.title: Spine vs Exode: Skeletal Animation for Games vs Skeletal Animation for Interfaces
items.en_title: Spine vs Exode: Skeletal Animation for Games vs Skeletal Animation for Interfaces
items.en_oneliner: Spine has been the default 2D skeletal animation tool in games for over a decade, while Exode added bones, IK and weight painting in the past year; their feature lists look alike on paper, but they target different artifacts, and picking the wrong one can cost months — this piece draws the practical line between them.

items.title: gta4-reversed: Starting a C++20 Runtime Reimplementation of GTA IV (1.0.7.0) — Crossing 1%
items.en_title: gta4-reversed: Starting a C++20 Runtime Reimplementation of GTA IV (1.0.7.0) — Crossing 1%
items.en_oneliner: An open-source C++20 project that reimplements the PC GTA IV 1.0.7.0 binary at runtime via ASI injection, now past its first milestone with 462 of 43,740 functions done; the code is MIT-licensed and ships no game files.
